newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain holds rates steady to help peseta.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain holds rates steady to help peseta.

text.p: The Bank of Spain refrained from cutting in its key interest rate Friday -- despite persistently high unemployment -- in the hope of calming a jittery peseta.

Milder-than-expected inflation data Thursday had raised market expectations that the central bank would sanction its second interest rate cut of the year. Consumer inflation fell to a 2.9 percent rate in January, its lowest in 28 years.
But the central bank decided to leave its key money market rate unchanged at 6 percent, apparently concerned by the peseta's shakiness this year, economists said.
